posts.zh:
dsh-auth-gateway 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。为 dsh web 提供密码与 TOTP 双因素认证网关：登录前拦截全部 HTTP/WebSocket 请求，含按来源锁定、全局限流与一次性备份代码。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-146ee6aea1c996d98881.html
posts.en:
dsh-auth-gateway is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Password + TOTP two-factor authentication gateway for the dsh web UI: every HTTP request and WebSocket upgrade is refused until login, with per-source lockout, global rate limits and one-time backup codes.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-146ee6aea1c996d98881.html
